`protocols/bead-layer-motion-v1.xml`. It carries `SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT`
and `Copyright © 2026 Bead contributors`. SHA256:
`52f4775621ff5fcfaa60e2824a8414f70bacd68e6a42a2a653846b3b9a45f20d`.
